ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle 1$ and $\angle 2$ are vertically opposite angles, $\angle 1 = 180^\circ - a$, $\angle 2 = 35^\circ$, then $a=$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle 1$ and $\angle 2$ are vertical angles,\\
it follows that $\angle 1 = \angle 2$,\\
Since $\angle 1=180^\circ-a$ and $\angle 2=35^\circ$,\\
it follows that $180^\circ-a=35^\circ$,\\
hence, $a=\boxed{145^\circ}$
